items.title: Design Engineer
items.location_text: United States, San Francisco, Canada, New York, Toronto
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a design engineer to help build and maintain Waypoint, our design system, across both the Figma library and the production codebase. This is not a "designer who codes a little" or an "engineer who dabbles in Figma" role. You should be genuinely fluent on both sides, comfortable defining a component's behavior and states in Figma one hour and shipping the same component to npm the next. You'll take direct ownership of the Figma side of our library (structure, variants, tokens, documentation) while also contributing to the core Waypoint system: our component packages, our token pipeline, and the tooling that keeps design and code in sync. If the idea of being the single point of continuity between a Figma frame and a production component sounds exciting rather than exhausting, this is your role. We're also thinking beyond the system we have today. Waypoint isn't just meant to serve designers and engineers, it's meant to become something a model can read, reason about, and build with directly. We want someone who can help us get there: grounded enough to do the unglamorous work of making today's system solid, and forward looking enough to help define what an intelligent design system looks like next. WHY THIS ROLE Waypoint is still early enough that the decisions you make now will shape how the system scales. You'll have real ownership, not just a queue of component tickets, and you'll be working alongside a team that treats design and engineering as one discipline rather than two departments that hand work back and forth. And you'll be helping define what a design system becomes when it has to serve a third audience: the models that will increasingly build with it. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams. - Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team. - Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced. - Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly. - Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff. - Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck. - Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows. - Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans. QUALIFICATIONS - Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams. - Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team. - Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced. - Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly. - Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff. - Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck. - Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows. - Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans. NICE-TO-HAVES - Experience building or contributing to design-to-code sync tooling (Figma plugins, token pipelines, MCP-based workflows, or similar). - Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and how to bake them into components rather than bolt them on. - Experience packaging and versioning component libraries for multiple consuming teams (npm scoped packages, semver, changelogs). - Exposure to multi-platform design systems work (iOS/SwiftUI, Android/Jetpack Compose, or token build tools like Style Dictionary). - Experience in an AI native product environment or genuine interest in how AI changes the way design systems get built and used. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Recruiter, GTM
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is growing quickly across EMEA, and we need recruiters who can help us hire exceptional people into the teams that bring our work to customers. We’re looking for a Recruiter, GTM to join our Talent team in Dublin and own full-cycle recruiting across our Go-To-Market organization, with a particular focus on Applied AI. This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role. You’ll partner with Applied AI and GTM leaders to define what great looks like, build pipelines in markets where these roles are still new, and close candidates who have competing offers. Some of the roles you’ll run won’t have an established market benchmark, so you’ll help build the playbook as well as follow it. Priorities shift quickly, and you’ll have real ownership of the searches you run. Key responsibilities Own full-cycle recruiting for Applied AI and broader GTM roles across EMEA, with a focus on London, Paris and Munich, from intake through offer and close Run intake sessions that scope the role, calibrate the bar, and challenge hiring managers where expectations don’t match the market Screen candidates against the JD with enough technical judgment to separate strong from merely well-presented Source and engage active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines in markets where talent is scarce Run structured, rigorous and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar Work with the broader Talent team, People Partners and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close Own pipeline health, tracking conversion, calibration and time-in-stage, and use the data to give hiring managers clear recommendations Help build and document the Applied AI and GTM hiring playbooks as the team scales Minimum qualifications 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a track record of closing strong candidates in competitive markets Demonstrated experience recruiting GTM or customer-facing roles in the UK and European markets, with working knowledge of local talent dynamics, compensation norms and employment practices Strong stakeholder partnership: you build trust quickly with senior hiring managers in fast-moving environments Willingness and ability to build technical depth quickly enough to run credible intake sessions and screens for Applied AI roles Proven ability to maintain quality under volume pressure and manage multiple searches at once Comfort with ambiguity and with building something new rather than running an established playbook Self-starter who works autonomously while staying aligned with global hiring strategy Genuine interest in Anthropic’s mission and an understanding of the role recruiting plays in achieving it Preferred qualifications Experience hiring technical customer-facing talent (Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, Sales Engineers, or Applied AI/ML-adjacent roles) at an AI, SaaS or high-growth technology company Experience recruiting across Sales, Partnerships or Marketing in addition to technical GTM roles Experience scoping roles that have no established market benchmark Experience hiring across multiple EMEA markets, including the UK, France and Germany Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms Additional European language skills (French or German especially) The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: €125.000 — €170.000 EUR Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The role As a Benefits Manager at Mistral, you will own and scale the benefits infrastructure supporting our team across multiple countries. You will partner closely with HR, Finance, and Legal to ensure our benefits offerings are competitive, compliant, and aligned with our growth, translating complex compliance and operational needs into streamlined, employee-focused experiences. What you'll do - Own benefits strategy end-to-end across our countries, including enrollment, renewals, changes, and offboarding, ensuring reliable issue resolution and compliance. - Drive benefits strategy by benchmarking market competitiveness, proposing local adjustments, and recommending offerings in line with our Total Rewards strategy. - Manage brokers, insurers, and benefits vendors: lead RFPs and renewals, negotiate cost-quality trade-offs, and enforce service level agreements. - Ensure compliance with local benefits, insurance, and social-security regulations in all operating jurisdictions, proactively adapting practices and flagging evolving risks in cooperation with Legal. - Design and enhance benefits processes and policies to be clear, scalable, and well-documented; lead impactful improvement projects as the company scales. - Leverage data to inform decisions by maintaining high-quality benefits data, building reporting and KPIs (such as cost per employee, participation, utilization, satisfaction), and translating insights into actionable recommendations. - Own the employee experience of benefits by delivering clear, empathetic communications during enrollment and life events and sensitively handling situations such as illness, family changes, or loss. - Partner with Finance for benefits budgeting and forecasting, and collaborate with HR Ops and payroll to ensure deductions and contributions are accurate and timely. - Serve as a key contributor on Mobility, working closely with cross-functional groups to keep our immigration and mobility offerings compliant and competitive. What we're looking for - Experience managing benefits for multi-country organizations during hypergrowth and new market entry - Deep knowledge of benefits regulations and practices in at least one core region (EU and/or US), with sound judgment for consulting experts - Skilled in managing, negotiating with, and holding external vendors and brokers accountable for cost and service quality - Proven ability to design, document, and improve scalable processes - Proficient in HRIS/benefits platforms, strong reporting, and keen on automation/AI to increase efficiency - Excellent stakeholder communication: empathetic with employees, credible with leadership on strategic trade-offs - Team-first, low-ego mindset with a focus on cross-functional collaboration and employee experience WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. items.title: Product Designer, Growth
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Growth at Anthropic is about helping people discover what Claude can do and make it part of how they work, from someone's first session to an entire company rolling out Claude. We're a small design team working across all of Anthropic's products, on problems that often don't have established playbooks, because the products and the capabilities behind them change so quickly. We drive growth by making the product itself better, favoring foundational changes and new product experiences over small optimizations. Our focus spans whatever most limits Anthropic's growth, and priorities can shift quickly. As a senior Product Designer on Growth, you'll own how Claude grows with people who use it for their everyday work. You'll dig into why some people make Claude a habit and others don't, find the real bottlenecks, and lead the product changes that move them. You'll set the vision for this area, partner closely with product, engineering, and data science, and raise the quality bar for the designers around you. We're looking for designers who thrive in ambiguity and pair sharp diagnostic judgment with exceptional craft. You form a clear point of view from messy signals, prototype quickly to test it, and drive alignment across teams to ship it. You use tools like Claude Code to explore ideas and push what's possible. Key responsibilities Own growth for how people use Claude in their everyday work, end to end, as your full-time focus Diagnose what drives deep, habitual use and what blocks it, combining data, research, and hands-on time in the product Set an opinionated vision for the area and turn it into a roadmap with your PM, engineering, and data science partners Redesign core parts of the product to drive growth, from onboarding and first-run experiences to the everyday workflows people rely on most Shape hypotheses and experiments, and judge results with a nuanced view of how we win, not just the topline metric Deliver exceptionally crafted interactions and set the quality bar for your area Drive alignment with partner teams whose work touches your area, connecting individual use to team and company adoption Mentor other designers, and frame problems clearly enough that others can own them Prototype and test ideas quickly with Claude Code and other AI tools Minimum qualifications A portfolio of shipped product design work that shows product vision and a high level of craft Experience owning growth for a major product area end to end, including diagnosing problems and setting direction Deep growth design experience in activation, onboarding, retention, engagement, or expansion, on a product at meaningful scale Hands-on experience designing, launching, and interpreting experiments, and using them to make product decisions Fluency with product analytics such as funnels, retention, and engagement Proficiency with design, prototyping, and AI tools, such as Figma and Claude Code, and a habit of learning new tools to push what's possible Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience driving alignment across product, engineering, and data science Preferred qualifications Experience leading growth strategy across multiple teams or product areas Experience designing enterprise/B2B SaaS, productivity, or collaboration tools Experience with product-led growth, from a single user to a team to a company-wide rollout Experience mentoring designers or shaping a design practice Comfort querying data yourself with SQL or a similar tool Experience prototyping with front-end code (e.g., HTML/CSS/JS) Experience defining AI-powered workflows for yourself or your team A clear point of view on when a product should ask for attention, and when it should stay out of the way Passion for building safe, beneficial AI that helps people do their best work Representative projects Diagnose why some people make a product part of their daily work and others drift away, then lead the changes that close the gap Redesign a core part of the product so people return to it more often and get more value each time Set the vision for a product's first-run experience and lead it through experiments to a redesigned, permanent flow Design the path from one person's daily use to their whole team adopting it The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $305,000 — $460,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Account Director, Cyber
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) that benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals together in one lab. Our Go To Market (GTM) team helps customers understand and deploy our highly capable AI products across their businesses. Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnerships work together to bring AI to as many users as possible. ABOUT THE ROLE As an Account Director, Large Enterprise — Cybersecurity, you’ll work with some of our largest cybersecurity customers, winning new business and expanding adoption within existing accounts. You’ll help these organizations apply AI across their products, security workflows, and business operations. This role combines cybersecurity industry knowledge, technical understanding, executive engagement, and ownership of complex enterprise sales. You’ll create demand, develop opportunities, and lead deals from initial engagement through negotiation, deployment, and expansion. You’ll help executives identify where AI can deliver meaningful value and build a practical path to realizing it. We’re looking for someone with a hunter mentality and a strong track record in the cybersecurity ecosystem. You’re comfortable engaging CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, product leaders, and other business executives, bringing commercial and technical stakeholders together around an enterprise AI strategy. Success means both winning business and helping customers turn their commitments into sustained adoption and consumption. This role can be based in our San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle offices. We are also considering applications to work remotely from within the U.S. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL: - Own a portfolio of large enterprise cybersecurity accounts, developing strategies that drive new business, enterprise adoption, and expansion. - Create demand through proactive prospecting, executive outreach, and a deep understanding of each customer’s business strategy, product roadmap, and security priorities. - Own complex deals end to end, including opportunity development, qualification, business case creation, technical evaluation, negotiation, and close. - Help executives identify opportunities to apply AI across cybersecurity products and workflows, such as security operations, threat analysis, incident response, and security engineering, in partnership with technical specialists. - Build relationships across security, engineering, product, business operations, and procurement teams, connecting stakeholders around shared goals. - Partner with solutions engineering to translate technical capabilities into customer programs with measurable business outcomes. - Navigate customer requirements around data privacy, sensitive security information, governance, and deployment, engaging the appropriate technical, security, and legal partners. - Win initial deployments and expand successful use cases across teams, business units, and geographies. - Own a consumption revenue target, partnering across the customer lifecycle to turn signed agreements into production usage and sustained growth. - Maintain rigorous account plans, opportunity management, and revenue forecasts, taking responsibility for advancing opportunities and resolving obstacles. - Bring cybersecurity customer and market insights to Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to inform our roadmap and approach. - Help build the processes, practices, and culture of a growing sales organization. WE’RE SEEKING SOMEONE WITH EXPERIENCE INCLUDING: - 14+ years selling complex platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service products to large enterprise customers, with substantial experience in cybersecurity. - Demonstrated success winning new customers and expanding existing accounts within the cybersecurity ecosystem. - A strong understanding of cybersecurity buyers, enterprise security workflows, and the commercial priorities of cybersecurity companies. - Generating pipeline and creating demand through proactive account development, including opportunities where the customer has not yet defined a project or allocated budget. - Designing and executing complex deal strategies with multiple decision-makers, technical requirements, security reviews, and procurement processes. - Selling across business units and functions, building support beyond a single buyer, team, or use case. - Working directly with C-level executives, including CISOs, CIOs, and CTOs, to connect technology investments to business strategy and measurable value. - Selling technically complex products in close partnership with engineering and solutions teams. - Navigating enterprise requirements related to data security, privacy, governance, and risk management. - Leading enterprise transformation opportunities from early discovery through deployment, adoption, and expansion. - Managing consumption-based revenue models, including forecasting usage, driving adoption, and identifying opportunities for growth. - Succeeding in fast-growing environments that require independent judgment, initiative, and accountability. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have a hunter mentality. You seek out opportunities, open doors, and build demand. You’re motivated by winning new customers and uncovering opportunities within established accounts. - Understand the cybersecurity landscape. You can engage credibly with security and product leaders, understand their priorities, and distinguish promising AI applications from those that require further evaluation. - Take ownership. You drive progress at every stage of a deal, set clear next steps, bring the right people together, and stay accountable when the path forward is unclear. - Can guide an executive journey. You meet leaders where they are, challenge their thinking thoughtfully, and help them develop a concrete vision for AI adoption. - Are customer-centric and commercially driven. You connect customer outcomes to durable growth and stay engaged as customers move from purchase to adoption. - Are technically curious. You enjoy understanding complex products and can explain their capabilities, limitations, and business implications to technical and nontechnical audiences. - Exercise sound judgment. You recognize the sensitivity of security use cases and work with the right partners to address customer requirements and support responsible deployment. - Think across the enterprise. You connect business units, build relationships across functions, and turn an initial use case into a broader adoption strategy. - Are a builder. You make sound decisions with incomplete information and help establish practices that allow a growing team to succeed. - Have a passion or deep curiosity for AI. You’re excited to help cybersecurity organizations deploy AI thoughtfully and deliver value to their businesses and users. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Stage - Applied Research in GenAI / NLP F/M
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME We are looking for curious and rigorous minds to push the boundaries of Generative AI at Betclic. Our GenAI Center of Excellence builds and runs generative-AI applications for the whole group. Among them is a semantic-analysis platform that turns millions of raw texts (customer conversations, support tickets, news) into clear, actionable themes for several business teams. The method behind it is the one the AI labs use on their own data. Anthropic’s Clio makes sense of millions of conversations with Claude without anyone reading them; GitHub and Google Research have published the same recipe: embed the texts, cluster them, let an LLM name what emerges. Each runs it on its own data; almost nobody applies it to everyday business text. We do. You will join the GenAI Center of Excellence in Bordeaux, working with GenAI solution architects and will be exposed to business teams expressing analysis needs. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC As a GenAI Research Intern at Betclic, you will work on a question this field has not answered yet. Today, these systems group texts by what they are about. Grouping them by an angle you choose (tone of voice, urgency, intent) means paying an LLM to rewrite every document first. Can the representation itself be oriented, so that steering costs almost nothing? And before that: how do you prove that one clustering is better than another? Your missions will include: Mapping the state of the art in LLM-assisted clustering, steerable embeddings and clustering evaluation. Designing an evaluation protocol (reference corpora, metrics, LLM-as-a-judge) and measuring how far it can be trusted. Running controlled experiments that compare clustering pipelines, embedding models and orientation techniques, on real corpora as well as public benchmarks. Writing up your protocols and conclusions as research notes, and presenting them to the team and to business stakeholders. This internship will give you hands-on experience of the methods the AI labs use on their own data, and a research question you own end to end, from hypothesis to conclusion. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for curious, passionate and collaborative people who enjoy solving problems and working in a dynamic environment. This internship is for you if you: Are currently enrolled in a Master’s degree (or equivalent, final year) in Machine Learning, Data Science, NLP, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. Have strong analytical skills and scientific rigour, are autonomous, and care more about why something works than about making it work once. Are proficient in Python and at ease building with LLMs and agents : LLM APIs, prompting, tool calling, and AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow. Want to grow your skills in communicating experimental results clearly, including what they do not prove. Work comfortably in English or French. Nice to have : Previous exposure to embeddings, clustering or topic modelling (e.g. sentence-transformers, UMAP, HDBSCAN, BERTopic), or to LLM APIs. A first research experience: a lab internship, a paper, or a habit of reproducible experiments. An interest in sports or gaming industries is appreciated, but not required. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? If your application is shortlisted, Maxime will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will meet your future manager. Finally, Maxime will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €10 per day (50% funded by Betclic) 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or a sustainable mobility allowance (€200 per year) 🏢 Extraordinary office space with a rooftop overlooking the Cité du Vin in Bordeaux 🎉 Internal events to brighten up your day-to-day life 🏋️ Free sports classes on-site And most of all, the opportunity to work in a young, fun, and vibrant atmosphere ! 6 months paid internship starting in February 2027 – Based in Bordeaux 📍 Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

items.description: About the Team OpenAI Finance ensures the organization is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Revenue team plays a critical role in enabling OpenAI to scale commercial offerings by overseeing billing operations, deal desk, revenue systems, revenue accounting, and controllership. We work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market, Tax, Legal, and Technical Accounting to support new monetization strategies, improve operational efficiency, and maintain financial integrity as the business grows. About the Role This senior leader will own key elements of Ads revenue accounting from technical assessment through operational execution. The role will guide accounting for products, pricing, contracts, incentives, credits, refunds, makegoods, international expansion, and new go-to-market motions. It will establish governance and translate approved accounting positions into launch, billing, data, close, reconciliation, and control requirements. Success requires deep technical revenue expertise, strong business partnership, and the ability to build durable 0-to-1 processes in a fast-changing environment. Advertising is a critical and growing monetization vector for OpenAI, and this role will help shape the financial foundations that enable Ads to scale responsibly and transparently. This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Lead technical accounting assessments for Ads products and commercial arrangements, including performance obligations, variable consideration, allocation, principal-versus-agent, collectibility, contract modifications, refunds, incentives, credits, makegoods, and revenue presentation. - Own and continuously evolve Ads revenue accounting policies and operating guidance as product behavior, pricing, contracting, incentive programs, and billing models change. - Establish governance for new products and accounting decisions, including intake, decision rights, materiality and escalation thresholds, launch approvals, policy versioning, decision logs, and post-launch monitoring. - Translate accounting conclusions into clear requirements for product design, contracting, billing, data, estimates, close, reconciliations, controls, and reporting. - Own the operating cadence for incentive and makegood accounting, invoice readiness, accruals and reserves, settlements, reconciliations, GL tie-outs, flux analysis, reporting, and control evidence. - Partner with Ads Product, Engineering, Data, Finance Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Tax, Billing, and Technical Accounting on launches, enterprise negotiations, and international expansion. - Prepare concise technical memos and audit-ready support; align novel or material conclusions with Corporate Technical Accounting and external auditors. - Use data, AI, and automation to improve research, monitoring, policy maintenance, issue tracking, documentation, and repeatable Finance workflows with appropriate review controls. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue accounting, including direct ownership of complex ASC 606 judgments and operational execution. - Demonstrated leadership to independently set direction, prioritize across competing risks, and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders. - Experience with digital advertising, adtech, marketplaces, payments, usage-based services, or another high-volume transaction environment. - Strong command of variable consideration, principal-versus-agent, contract modifications, incentives and credits, collectibility, estimates, and revenue presentation. - Track record building 0-to-1 accounting processes, governance, close mechanisms, reconciliations, and controls that scale. - Ability to turn technical conclusions into practical product, contract, billing, data, and operating requirements. - Clear, concise written and executive communication, including audit-ready documentation and evidence-based recommendations. Preferred Qualifications: - Experience supporting global launches, multiple currencies, international contracting entities, intercompany considerations, or localized billing models. - Experience applying AI or automation within Finance while maintaining review, validation, and control standards. - Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data, or Finance systems teams. - Experience developing or leading high-performing accounting teams or distributed operating groups. - Background in public-company controllership, technical accounting, audit, or similarly rigorous control environments. items.title: Software Engineer, HSM Infrastructure Security, Consumer Devices
items.description: We are hiring a Security Software Engineer to design and implement the hardware-backed security foundations used across OpenAI’s device ecosystem. A central focus of this role is hardening the boundary between our policy systems and the HSMs that protect sensitive cryptographic keys. This boundary determines which operations may be performed, what may be signed, which policies must be satisfied, and how changes to trusted software and policy are authorized. You will develop security-critical software and firmware within, or immediately adjacent to, an HSM trust boundary. Depending on your background, this may include HSM trusted applications, firmware services, cryptographic mechanisms, device drivers, PKCS#11 components, secure-provisioning protocols, or signing-policy enforcement systems. This is a hands-on software-engineering role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review production code, debug across hardware and software boundaries, and carry projects from initial requirements through deployment. It is not an HSM administration, PKI operations, compliance, or architecture-only position. In This Role, You Will - Design and implement security-critical software and firmware for HSMs, secure elements, trusted execution environments, and hardware roots of trust. - Build and harden the policy-to-HSM boundary responsible for authorizing certificate issuance and cryptographic signing operations. - Develop HSM trusted applications, firmware components, host interfaces, device drivers, SDKs, or cryptographic service integrations. - Implement or extend cryptographic interfaces such as PKCS#11, OpenSSL providers or engines, platform key-storage APIs, or comparable hardware-security interfaces. - Build firmware and software that cryptographically enforces key generation, provisioning, usage, rotation, recovery, and destruction policies. - Design and implement HSM-backed certificate authority, code-signing, key-management, and device-identity systems. - Develop end-to-end cryptographic protocols spanning devices, secure hardware, policy services, and backend infrastructure. - Build security capabilities supporting device attestation, secure boot, factory provisioning and restoration, user registration, and authentication. - Design controls that make trusted software and policy changes verifiable, auditable, and subject to appropriate multi-party authorization. - Write, review, test, and audit secure embedded software for resource-constrained environments. - Develop test harnesses, emulators, fuzzers, and fault-injection tooling to validate security properties and failure behavior. - Threat-model hardware and software trust boundaries and translate findings into concrete engineering improvements. - Partner with hardware, firmware, infrastructure, application, and security teams to integrate secure-by-default capabilities into production systems. - Help establish engineering standards for HSM development, applied cryptography, secure key management, and certificate infrastructure. Minimum Qualifications - 5+ years experience building secure embedded firmware for constrained environments - Deep programming experience in C, C++, or Rust. You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have - A strong track record of designing, implementing, debugging, and shipping production systems software. - Hands-on experience developing security-critical software or firmware within, or directly adjacent to, an HSM, secure element, TEE, or hardware root of trust. - Experience developing one or more of the following: - HSM firmware or trusted applications - Cryptographic mechanisms or hardware-accelerated cryptographic services - HSM device drivers, host libraries, SDKs, or middleware - PKCS#11 providers, mechanisms, or integrations - Secure key-provisioning or key-injection protocols - HSM-backed certificate authority or code-signing systems - Signing-policy enforcement within a hardware-backed trust boundary - Strong knowledge of applied cryptography, digital signatures, key hierarchies, secure key management, and cryptographic protocol design. - Experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, certificate authorities, certificate issuance, and certificate lifecycle protocols. - Familiarity with secure boot, measured boot, device identity, remote attestation, or hardware-backed storage. - Experience reasoning about concurrency, memory safety, privilege separation, hardware interfaces, failure modes, and side-channel or physical attack considerations. - The ability to evaluate security designs and personally implement the software required to realize them. - Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across hardware, firmware, backend, and product teams. Additional Experience That May Be Helpful - Firmware development for ARM TrustZone or another trusted execution environment. - Experience with commercial or cloud HSM platforms such as Thales Luna, Entrust/nShield, Utimaco, Marvell LiquidSecurity, AWS CloudHSM, or comparable systems. - Experience with PKCS#11, KMIP, OpenSSL providers or engines, secure-element APIs, or platform-native key-storage frameworks. - Device manufacturing, secure provisioning, factory restore, or silicon bring-up experience. - Secure boot ROM, bootloader, firmware-signing, anti-rollback, or authenticated-update development. - Developing trusted applications or cryptographic services inside an HSM or secure coprocessor. - Hardware/software co-design involving cryptographic accelerators, secure processors, or custom silicon. - Multi-party authorization, quorum-controlled deployments, tamper-resistant audit mechanisms, or attestable policy systems. - Secure or private storage systems based on hardware-protected keys. - Experience sustaining high-assurance security software in production. items.title: Customer Experience Manager, Executive Office
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood's Customer Experience team is committed to providing high-quality, comprehensive support for our customers, many of whom are investing for the first time. As a key part of this organization, the Executive Office team represents the most senior tier of support at Robinhood CX. Our team takes direct ownership of cases that reach our executives, legal team, and regulatory bodies. We work diligently to resolve the most complex, sensitive issues our customers face with ethics and integrity at the core of our operations! As the Customer Experience Manager, Executive Office , you will lead a highly skilled team of senior specialists responsible for navigating some of our most complex and sensitive customer issues. You will set the strategy and standards for exceptional resolution, equipping your team with the judgment, tools, and support needed to confidently manage executive, legal, and regulatory escalations. You will monitor complaint themes and customer friction to identify opportunities for broader improvement, partnering closely with senior CX leadership, Compliance, Legal, Product, and other cross-functional teams to address root causes and strengthen the customer experience. This is a high-visibility leadership role where you will develop senior talent, drive consistent and thoughtful resolution practices, and ensure the team is prepared to navigate even the most challenging customer situations. This role is based in our Denver, CO and Westlake, TX office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Partner with CX Senior Leadership to set strategy and lead day-to-day operations for complaints management and escalations across our most complex and sensitive customer issues. Lead and develop a team of senior Customer Experience specialists, setting clear expectations and building the judgment and capabilities needed to navigate complex customer situations. Coach and develop senior specialists to raise the performance bar, strengthen decision-making, and deliver thoughtful, consistent resolutions. Establish and continuously improve resolution strategies, operating standards, and escalation practices across the team. Monitor key performance indicators, complaint trends, and customer friction to identify emerging risks and opportunities for improvement. Translate insights from complex cases into systemic improvements, partnering across Compliance, Legal, Product, Operational Readiness, and CX leadership to address root causes. Advise CX leadership on complaint and escalation trends and how they should inform broader business priorities and customer experience strategy. Partner closely with Compliance and other key stakeholders to ensure complaint-management practices balance customer outcomes, operational effectiveness, and regulatory requirements. Identify opportunities to improve tooling, processes, knowledge, and automation that enable specialists to resolve complex issues more effectively. Elevate the voice of the customer, ensuring insights from our most challenging cases inform decisions and improvements across the broader business. What you bring Demonstrated experience leading escalations, complaints management, or other complex customer operations. Proven ability to lead and develop experienced teams, including coaching sound judgment and decision-making in complex or ambiguous situations. Strong operational leadership skills with experience setting performance expectations, using data to identify opportunities, and delivering measurable results. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities, including the ability to identify patterns and root causes beyond individual customer cases. Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across senior leaders and cross-functional partners, including Compliance, Legal, Product, and Operations. Minimum four years of experience in a Customer Care management role. Bachelor's degree in a related field. Series 7, 63, and 24 Designated Principal licenses (Series 9/10 accepted in lieu of the 24). Series 66 and Series 3 required within 180 days of hire. Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them: Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech. Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly. Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more! Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. items.title: Systems Architect
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a RevOps Systems Architect to design and build the systems behind a modern, AI-powered go-to-market engine. This isn’t a Salesforce admin role, and it isn’t a support function. You’ll be the technical owner of how our GTM stack fits together: Salesforce at the core, surrounded by the data, enrichment, engagement, billing, and AI tools our revenue teams depend on. You’ll operate as an architect and a hands-on builder. You’ll set the technical direction for our CRM and GTM tooling, then ship it yourself with Flows, Apex, SQL, and custom services, including Salesforce MCP servers and AI tooling that make our CRM a first-class participant in AI-driven workflows. For larger efforts, you’ll partner with our engineering team, scoping, designing, and delivering together as a technical peer. In this role, you will: - Own the architecture of our GTM systems: the Salesforce object model and data architecture, how data moves between Salesforce and the rest of the stack, and the standards that keep it all healthy and scalable. - Design and build integrations between Salesforce and adjacent tools (data warehouse, enrichment, sales engagement, billing/CPQ, internal apps), choosing the right tool for each problem, whether that’s native Salesforce, Apex, middleware, or custom services. - Build and maintain automations using Flows, Apex, and custom services that power GTM processes end to end, with a bias toward solutions that are intelligent, observable, and maintainable. - Develop and maintain Salesforce MCP servers and AI agents that extend CRM functionality into AI-powered workflows, and define how AI fits into our revenue operations over time. - Design and own SQL-based data pipelines that feed dashboards and revenue reporting, making sure the numbers leadership relies on are trustworthy and traceable to source. - Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical strategy, from stakeholder conversation through design, build, rollout, and adoption. - Raise the bar for the team: establish best practices for change management, testing, documentation, and technical debt, and mentor teammates on systems thinking. - Partner with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering to prioritize the systems work with the highest business impact. REQUIREMENTS - 8+ years in Salesforce administration and development, with a track record of owning a complex, high-growth org and its architecture, not just maintaining it. - Strong Apex skills: you can design, build, debug, and maintain triggers, custom logic, and integrations independently, and you know when not to write code. - Demonstrated experience integrating Salesforce with other systems via APIs, middleware, or custom services, and designing for failure modes, data integrity, and scale. - SQL proficiency: you decompose ambiguous questions into well-structured queries and are comfortable with complex joins, aggregations, and pipeline logic. - A systems mindset: you can hold an end-to-end GTM process in your head, trace a field from origin through every downstream dependency, and anticipate what breaks when something changes. - Strong judgment and ownership: you scope problems yourself, make sound build-vs-buy and architecture calls, and drive projects to completion with little direction. - Clear communicator who can explain tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and earn trust across teams. - Excited by AI-native systems and curious about where Salesforce, MCP, and AI agents intersect. You’re already experimenting in this space. Bonus: - Familiarity with dbt or modern data transformation tooling. - Experience with BI tools such as Sigma or Looker. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Sr. Counsel - Labor & Employment
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. This is a fully remote role, for an EU- or UK-qualified attorney working out of the EU or the UK, to join Payward’s world class in-house legal department, reporting to the Global Head of Labor & Employment. THE OPPORTUNITY - Augment the Labor & Employment (L&E) legal team and act as the subject matter expert for the EU and UK, providing local-law advice in European time zones and, as needed, supporting L&E matters in MENA and APAC in coordination with local counsel - Take first-line ownership of recurring EU and UK employment matters, including worker classification issues, employee separations and employee relations, executive compensation agreements, and wage-and-hour matters - Work with executive leadership, existing employment counsel, and the Payward Experience (PX) team to develop the L&E practice for a rapidly growing global/worldwide workforce - Advise on and manage works council, collective consultation, pay transparency, and employee representative matters, and prepare the company for new consultation obligations as its European footprint grows, including in connection with restructurings and acquisitions - items.title: Senior Analyst, Travel & Expense
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role As a Senior Analyst, Travel & Expense, you will run the day-to-day financial controls, audit program, and executive reporting behind Anthropic's T&E function. T&E touches every employee, every legal entity, and every executive, and it runs on Navan, Brex, and negotiated supplier agreements. Spend and transaction volume have grown several-fold in the past six quarters, and the controls need to scale to meet a public-company standard. You will report to the Head of Travel & Expense in Finance Operations and work daily with Accounting, Tax, Payroll, Talent, Security, Legal, Finance Systems and Administrative Business Partners. Responsibilities Controls & SOX Compliance Own the day-to-day operation of key T&E controls, including approvals, card issuance and spend limits, segregation of duties, and policy exceptions, within the control framework set by the Head of T&E, who owns the overall T&E process Maintain the T&E process narratives and risk and control matrix, and keep them current as systems and policies change Ensure correct GL coding and complete, accurate month-end reconciliations across Navan, Brex, and Workday, and support close, flux analysis, and accruals Act as the preparer for T&E controls and the day-to-day contact for internal and external auditors: gather and retain evidence, support walkthroughs and sample requests, and track remediation, escalating significant issues to the Head of T&E International Expansion Controls Set up and maintain entity-level coding and approval flows in Brex and Navan as new legal entities and countries come online Document and operationalize country-specific rules for per diems, VAT reclaim, non-USD cards, receipt requirements, and local tax treatment Partner with Tax, Payroll, and Global Mobility to ensure compliance Support accurate intercompany treatment of T&E costs across entities T&E Audit Program Help design, build, and run a risk-based audit program covering sampling, anomaly detection, misuse escalation, and remediation tracking Define and monitor pre-spend rules, duplicate and split-transaction checks, and receipt and 30-day submission compliance Build dashboards and reporting on policy compliance, exceptions, and control performance for Finance leadership Partner with the Head of T&E to deploy Claude to review transactions, flag policy exceptions, and automate recurring reporting Program Operations Own day-to-day T&E operations, supporting the growing volume of travel and expense activity and platform configuration and automation, so operations keep running without pulling focus from controls Own transaction-level review and receipt follow-up, and help shape what should be automated rather than staffed Partner with Benefits, Payroll and Legal to ensure the T&E program is compliant with relevant local and country requirements Preferred qualifications 7+ years of experience in travel and expense, corporate accounting, internal audit, or finance operations, ideally at a high-growth technology company Hands-on SOX or internal-controls experience: writing process narratives, testing or operating key controls, and working with external auditors Strong accounting fundamentals, including GL coding, account reconciliations, accruals, and month-end close support Deep platform expertise in Navan and/or comparable TMC platforms, plus Brex or equivalent expense management tools, and working knowledge of ERP integrations (Workday preferred) Strong analytical skills: comfort with large transaction datasets, sampling methods, and anomaly detection Sound judgment and discretion with sensitive information, and the ability to work credibly with senior executives and their support teams Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a control or an exception to Finance leaders, auditors, and employees An AI-curious, builder mindset: experience automating finance workflows with AI tools, or real enthusiasm for doing so, and comfort creating structure where none exists CPA, CIA, or equivalent certification Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency environments, including per diem rules, VAT reclaim, and cross-border tax considerations Experience with pre-IPO or newly public company readiness M&A integration experience a huge plus The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $190,000 — $230,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
