items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Web3 Backend
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. As a Senior Software Engineer , you’ll architect, build, and scale the backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s next-generation crypto, web3, and wallet offerings. You’ll provide technical leadership to deliver a best-in-class trading experience for cryptocurrencies and tokenized assets—including perpetual futures—to customers worldwide, solving complex distributed systems and correctness challenges in an environment where the systems you build move real customer assets continuously around the clock. The Robinhood Wallet team’s mission is to democratize access to financial services worldwide by leveraging DeFi protocols and Robinhood Chain. The team builds non-custodial consumer products, self-custody experiences, and seamless cross-chain trading capabilities. The Tokenization team’s mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; the team builds the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure and on-chain systems—issuance, custody, and settlement—to change that. The Robinhood Chain team designs and scales the underlying decentralized infrastructure across Robinhood. The team continuously improves Robinhood Chain to provide a best-in-class decentralized platform for trading real-world assets, builds specialized smart contracts, and provides infrastructure services for other Robinhood teams that rely on DeFi. This role is based in our Toronto office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Build scalable systems and components, making the right tradeoffs to account for stability and long-term maintainability. Design, write, test, and release critical technical solutions with high engineering rigor. Collaborate with multi-functional teams and deliver large-scope technical quality projects Mentor junior developers on the team and lead project of large complexity Find opportunities to improve system performance, team efficiency, and minimize risks What you bring 5+ years of software development experience working in a fast paced environment. 3+ years experience writing low latency, large scale distributed systems for Crypto domains. Proficiency in Go or Python, with exceptional technical grasp with problem-solving and production debugging skills. Strong ownership and experience building and operating high-scale, distributed systems across the full software lifecycle. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and across engineering teams. Experience mentoring junior developers and leading the team technically on new initiatives and system improvement. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs Our team is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming interview experience for all candidates. items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As an HR Business Partner, you will support managers and employees throughout the employee lifecycle while helping Mistral AI build scalable people practices as the company grows. You will be a trusted partner, providing guidance on people matters and helping leaders make informed decisions. You will work across both day-to-day people topics and longer-term initiatives, from employee relations and career development to performance reviews, learning, and talent retention. You will play a key role in creating a consistent employee experience across multiple countries while ensuring compliance with local employment regulations. You will also help shape how the People team operates by improving policies, processes, and programs that support the business and reinforce Mistral AI's culture. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Partner with managers to provide trusted guidance on people-related matters. - Support a positive and productive work environment by proactively addressing employee concerns and engagement. - Use People metrics to inform decisions and provide insights to managers and leadership. - Champion and reinforce Mistral AI's culture across the organization. - Develop and evolve talent retention initiatives that support long-term employee growth. - Design and improve learning, career development, and performance review programs. - Build scalable People policies and processes that promote sustainable ways of working, including work-life balance. items.title: Privacy Program Manager
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives. You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment. RESPONSIBILITIES - Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls. - Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements. - Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data. - Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle. - Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records. - Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines. - Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation. - Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions. - Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve. - Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders. - Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance. - Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company. WHO YOU ARE - Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data. - An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes. - Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams. - Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction. - Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. WHAT YOU BRING - 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company. - Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements. - Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation. - Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks. - Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams. - Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar. - Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus. - Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced U.S. based Privacy Counsel to join our Legal Team. In this role, you will help shape and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program as the company continues to expand internationally. You will advise on privacy, data protection, and AI governance issues across our products and operations, while supporting commercial transactions involving data processing and technology services. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and GTM teams to provide practical, business-oriented guidance that enables innovation while ensuring compliance with evolving privacy and AI regulatory frameworks across multiple jurisdictions. RESPONSIBILITIES - Advise on global privacy and data protection laws, including CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, and other U.S. and international regulatory frameworks. - Advise on privacy and regulatory risks relating to AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, and other sensitive data types. - Partner with Product and Engineering teams to implement privacy-by-design principles and support responsible development of AI products. - Conduct and oversee privacy risk assessments, including Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)and related documentation. - Support commercial transactions by advising on data protection terms, including Data Processing Addendums (DPAs), Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), cross-border data transfers, and privacy provisions in customer agreements. - Monitor and interpret evolving legal and regulatory developments relating to privacy, AI governance, and data use, and translate them into practical guidance for the business. - Help develop and maintain ElevenLabs’ privacy policies, procedures, and governance frameworks. - Support responses to privacy-related regulatory inquiries, audits, and incidents, working closely with Security and Safety teams. WHO YOU ARE - Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, with a strong sense of ownership and enthusiasm for applying privacy law to cutting-edge products. - Comfortable navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving regulatory landscapes. - Able to translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical guidance for product and business teams. - Collaborative, pragmatic, and solutions-oriented, with a strong commitment to enabling innovation responsibly. WHAT YOU BRING - JD with active membership in at least one U.S. state bar (New York preferred). - 6+ years of relevant legal experience, with a focus on privacy compliance and data governance. - Experience advising AI, technology or SaaS companies on global privacy compliance and data governance. - Experience advising on US biometric privacy laws and regulatory requirements, including laws governing biometric identifiers and information. - Experience advising on HIPAA, healthcare privacy, PHI, and BAAs, particularly in connection with technology or SaaS products. - Experience advising on AI, data use, or emerging technology regulatory frameworks is a strong plus. - Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar. - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
